TextBuffer.name: getTextSnapshot
TextBuffer.description: Capture immutable text without copying the document. The snapshot remains valid after edits, undo and buffer destruction. Its read interface exposes length, lineCount, slice(start, end), charCodeAt(index), chunks(), lines(startRow, endRow), lineReader(), positionAt(index) and offsetAt(point). subtext(start, end) captures a shared subrange; replace(start, end, text) returns a new snapshot, accepting a string or another snapshot. Neither operation mutates the captured text or materializes the whole document. mapChunks(mapper, {cache, signal, isCurrent}) asynchronously transforms bounded chunks with cooperative yields. A cache is a WeakMap owned by one pure context-free mapper; unchanged branches are reused across revisions. The mapper receives a string and synchronously returns a string or snapshot. It must preserve its own semantics across arbitrary chunk boundaries. commonPrefixLength(other, limit) and commonSuffixLength(other, limit) compare UTF-16 units exactly while skipping shared immutable branches. The default limit is the shorter snapshot's length. A line reader returns a row-to-text function with efficient sequential reads and indexed jumps; requests outside the snapshot return undefined. Offsets count UTF-16 units; line iteration strips LF/CRLF and uses an exclusive end row. Explicit string reads materialize only their range. Read .getTextRevision alongside the snapshot when preparing an asynchronous edit plan, then pass that revision when applying the plan.

TextBuffer.description: Capture a clipped buffer range as immutable shared text without creating a string. Snapshot offsets and row positions are relative to the range start. Workspace.name: paneForURI
Workspace.description: Get the first Pane that contains an item with the given URI.

Workspace.name: panelForItem
Workspace.description: Find the panel displaying a given item.

Workspace.name: popModal
Workspace.description: Go back one step in the modal breadcrumb trail.

Workspace.name: popModalTo
Workspace.description: Jump back to an earlier step of the modal breadcrumb trail.

Workspace.name: registerFileDocument
Workspace.description: Register a shared document for explicit filesystem moves in this workspace.

Workspace.name: reopenItem
Workspace.description: Asynchronously reopens the last-closed item's URI if it hasn't already been reopened.

Workspace.name: replace
Workspace.description: Performs a replace across all the specified files in the project on disk. Open text buffers receive the disk edits and retain nonoverlapping unsaved changes. Different overlapping edits leave the buffer conflicted. Buffer-only matches are not replaced, and unsaved changes are not written to disk.

Workspace.name: resolveCommandContext
Workspace.description: Capture a command's presentation and document targets before asynchronous work.

Workspace.name: saveActivePaneItem
Workspace.description: Save the workspace center's active pane item.

Workspace.name: saveActivePaneItemAs
Workspace.description: Prompt for a path and save the workspace center's active pane item to it.

Workspace.name: scan
Workspace.description: Performs a search across all files in the workspace as they exist on disk. Open text buffers are not searched.

Workspace.name: toggle
Workspace.description: Search the workspace for items matching the given URI. If any are found, hide them. Otherwise, open the URL.

WorkspaceCenter.name: activateNextPane
WorkspaceCenter.description: Make the next pane active.

WorkspaceCenter.name: activatePreviousPane
WorkspaceCenter.description: Make the previous pane active.

WorkspaceCenter.name: getActivePane
WorkspaceCenter.description: Get the active Pane.

WorkspaceCenter.name: getActivePaneItem
WorkspaceCenter.description: Get the active Pane's active item.

WorkspaceCenter.name: getActiveTextEditor
WorkspaceCenter.description: Get the active item if it is an TextEditor.

WorkspaceCenter.name: getPaneContainers
WorkspaceCenter.description: Get all document containers in this center.

WorkspaceCenter.name: getPaneItems
WorkspaceCenter.description: Get all pane items in the workspace center.

WorkspaceCenter.name: getPanes
WorkspaceCenter.description: Get all panes in the workspace center.

WorkspaceCenter.name: getTextEditors
WorkspaceCenter.description: Get all text editors in the workspace center.

WorkspaceCenter.name: observeActivePane
WorkspaceCenter.description: Invoke the given callback with the current active pane and when the active pane changes.

WorkspaceCenter.name: observeActivePaneItem
WorkspaceCenter.description: Invoke the given callback with the current active pane item and with all future active pane items in the workspace center.

WorkspaceCenter.name: observePaneContainers
WorkspaceCenter.description: Observe current and future document containers.

WorkspaceCenter.name: observePaneItems
WorkspaceCenter.description: Invoke the given callback with all current and future panes items in the workspace center.

WorkspaceCenter.name: observePanes
WorkspaceCenter.description: Invoke the given callback with all current and future panes in the workspace center.

WorkspaceCenter.name: observeTextEditors
WorkspaceCenter.description: Invoke the given callback with all current and future text editors in the workspace center.

WorkspaceCenter.name: onDidAddPane
WorkspaceCenter.description: Invoke the given callback when a pane is added to the workspace center.

WorkspaceCenter.name: onDidAddPaneItem
WorkspaceCenter.description: Invoke the given callback when a pane item is added to the workspace center.

WorkspaceCenter.name: onDidAddTextEditor
WorkspaceCenter.description: Invoke the given callback when a text editor is added to the workspace center.

WorkspaceCenter.name: onDidChangeActivePane
WorkspaceCenter.description: Invoke the given callback when the active pane changes.

WorkspaceCenter.name: onDidChangeActivePaneItem
WorkspaceCenter.description: Invoke the given callback when the active pane item changes.

WorkspaceCenter.name: onDidDestroyPane
WorkspaceCenter.description: Invoke the given callback when a pane is destroyed in the workspace center.

WorkspaceCenter.name: onDidDestroyPaneItem
WorkspaceCenter.description: Invoke the given callback when a pane item is destroyed.

WorkspaceCenter.name: onDidStopChangingActivePaneItem
WorkspaceCenter.description: Invoke the given callback when the active pane item stops changing.

WorkspaceCenter.name: onWillDestroyPane
WorkspaceCenter.description: Invoke the given callback before a pane is destroyed in the workspace center.

WorkspaceCenter.name: onWillDestroyPaneItem
WorkspaceCenter.description: Invoke the given callback when a pane item is about to be destroyed, before the user is prompted to save it.

WorkspaceDropManager.name: rollback

fuzzyMatcher.name: score

fuzzyMatcher.name: setCandidates

lumine.tools.name: fuzzyMatcher
lumine.tools.description: Fuzzy matching utilities used by symbol lists, file search and the command palette. Available as lumine.tools.fuzzyMatcher.

lumine.tools.name: removeDiacritics
lumine.tools.description: Removes diacritical marks from a string, so that "café" can be matched by typing "cafe".

lumine.tools.fuzzyMatcher.name: match

lumine.tools.fuzzyMatcher.name: score

lumine.tools.fuzzyMatcher.name: setCandidates

Icon.name: classes
Icon.description: Create a glyph-font icon. The provider supplies the CSS for the given classes; the editor applies them unchanged.

Icon.name: coerce
Icon.description: Rebuild a provider's descriptor with its structural classes and provider identity. Throws a TypeError for values that are not descriptors.

Icon.name: equal
Icon.description: Compare descriptors by their rendered fields. Provider identity is ignored; two identical absent values also compare equal.

Icon.name: image
Icon.description: Create an image icon addressed by URL, such as a data: URL from the OS or a file: URL from an icon theme. The editor paints it in its icon box.

Icon.name: isDescriptor
Icon.description: Test whether a value was created by these descriptor factories.

Icon.name: letter
Icon.description: Create a badge from the first Unicode code point of a string.

Icon.name: none
Icon.description: Explicitly suppress an icon. This stops provider resolution; returning null instead lets the next provider answer.

Icon.name: svg
Icon.description: Create an inline SVG icon rendered into a child element. Markup is supplied by the provider and is not sanitized.

lumine.tools.markdown.name: applySyntaxHighlighting
lumine.tools.markdown.description: Uses Lumine's built-in Syntax Highlighting system to apply the same syntax highlighting to code blocks within markdown. Modifies the existing object passed.

lumine.tools.markdown.name: convertToDOM
lumine.tools.markdown.description: Parse an HTML string into a detached DocumentFragment. This should be done if you need access to APIs available on the DOM itself.

lumine.tools.markdown.name: render
lumine.tools.markdown.description: Takes a Markdown document and renders it as HTML.

lumine.tools.completionMatcher.name: createQuery
lumine.tools.completionMatcher.description: Prepare one completion query. Results keep their score and lazily computed UTF-16 match indices together. This scorer does not apply path bonuses. Matches also expose exact, prefix, caseSensitivePrefix and firstCharacterMatches flags using the same normalization as scoring. Queries longer than 256 UTF-16 units produce no matches. Cached candidate text is bounded to 2048 entries and 262144 UTF-16 units per query.
